**Answer:** The fix is commit `21ea98bd` ("TRUNK-6796: Fix NPE whe death date is null when merging patients (#6537)", by Mandeep, 2026-10-07). It changed the null check on line 445 of `PersonMergeLogData.java`. The `computeHashValue()` line tested `getPriorDateOfBirth()` but then called `getPriorDateOfDeath().toString()`. The fix tests `getPriorDateOfDeath()` instead. The commit also adds `PersonMergeLogDataTest`, which asserts that `computeHashValue()` does not throw when the prior date of death is null.

**Evidence, best first:**

1. The fix itself, in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/person/PersonMergeLogData.java` at line 445. The diff for commit `21ea98bd` changes the condition from `getPriorDateOfBirth() != null` to `getPriorDateOfDeath() != null`. The surrounding lines are 442–446.
2. The `computeHashValue()` method in the same file, lines 392–448. The buggy line was the same line 445 before the fix.
3. The regression test `openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/person/PersonMergeLogDataTest.java`, lines 18–27 (added in the commit). It sets only the prior date of birth and asserts that `computeHashValue()` does not throw.
4. The existing hash-consistency test `openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/api/PersonServiceTest.java`, lines 1510–1514, which calls `computeHashValue()` on a merge log before and after retrieval. It is related context, not part of the fix.
5. Commit `21ea98bdb1d1ca38a2986de62de17b8e3f7bd8a3` (openmrs-core).
6. PR #6537 in openmrs-core, referenced in the commit message.
7. Ticket TRUNK-6796.

I did not run the test suite; the conclusions come from reading the diff and the source.
